tasks.title: Retire outcome on the card revision + Telegram delete/receipt
tasks.objective: The card projection marks a retire revision allowed|denied (denied/expired rows carried); shared text renders per-row 'Permission denied: <label>' / 'Expired: <label>' receipts; the durable-send wiring delivers an allowed retire as a delete of the provider message (receipt fallback) and a denied retire as an edit; Telegram deletes (editMessageText receipt on failure); deletedAt/receiptMessageId recorded on the revision so retries no-op. Unit + Postgres coverage.
acceptance_criteria: when every row of a job permission card is settled by Allow, the card message is deleted on Telegram, Discord and Slack and edited to a one-line approved receipt on Teams; a failed delete falls back to the receipt edit.
when any row is denied or expired, the card is edited to a one-line receipt per denied/expired request ('Permission denied: <command>' / 'Expired: <command>') on every provider — never deleted.
the retire outcome (allowed | denied) is carried on the card revision by the shared projection; provider deliveries act on it; retry of a retire revision is idempotent.
existing unit and Postgres integration suites pass (only new or updated assertions on the retire text/operation); tsc, architecture check green.

required_tests.id: deletes a fully allowed card on retire and falls back to a receipt edit
